column1: # Adaptive root cut-generator skip (CbcModel::setCutGeneratorAdaptiveSkip(),
# see CbcModel.cpp's serialCuts()) sweep configs for cutskip-sweep.
# Format: one config per line, tab-separated
#   <name>\t<comma-separated overrides, or - for none>
# Each override token is either KEY=VAL (exported as an env var) or
# CLI:<arg> (appended as an extra cbc command-line argument -- needed to
# force a bit OFF, since env vars can only turn adaptive-skip on, never
# override an already-on default).
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped.
# "today" must always be present -- it is the baseline every other config
# is compared against.
# As of the 2026-09 sweep result below, adaptive-skip (default constants:
# MIN_TRIES=3, MISS_THRESHOLD=3, INITIAL_PERIOD=5, MAX_PERIOD=20,
# MIN_COLS=500) is now CBC's SHIPPED DEFAULT for the `cbc` CLI (see
# CbcParam::MOREMOREMIPOPTIONS's default in CbcParameters.cpp) -- it beat
# every other miss-threshold tried (2/4/5) on every metric (dual/primal
# gap closed, bbTime, dual/primal efficiency) on the full 442-instance
# mip-sanity-data set and the 176-instance hard subset; see
# ROOT-FIXTURES.md for the full numbers.
# Consequently:
#   - "today"    = current shipped default = adaptive-skip ON (no override
#                  needed -- kept as "-" so this file stays a no-op the day
#                  the shipped default changes again).
#   - "pre_flip" = the OLD shipped default (feature off), forced via
#                  -more2MipOptions=off, kept so a future change can still
#                  be regression-tested against the pre-2026-09 behavior.
today
pre_flip
# Alternate miss-threshold values already tried and confirmed worse than
# the tuned default (3) on the 176-instance hard set -- kept here for
# convenience if the binary/instance set changes enough to warrant a
# re-check, not because they're expected to win.
miss_threshold_2
miss_threshold_4
miss_threshold_5
